description: Shuffle answer positions across all 10 papers in index.html (MCQ, fill-in-the-blank, and Match-the-following sections) so the correct answer is no longer consistently the first option, and keep the Std 1 and Std 2 papers in Computer_Std_1_to_10_Question_Papers.md consistent with the corresponding index.html papers. index.html has no embedded answer key, so the correct answer is identified as the current first option (position A/[A]) and moved; the change is position-only and self-consistent. Depends on the audit-map produced in FEAT-001.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-shuffle-answer-options/audit-map.md for the correct-answer text and planned new position of every index.html block.

For EACH paper article (paper-std-1 through paper-std-10) in index.html: for every MCQ
block, reorder the
LABEL) text
children so the correct answer (the one identified in FEAT-001 as the current first option) moves to its planned new position, then re-letter A) B) C) D) to match the new physical order. Keep each and the Marathi/English text intact.

For every fill-in-the-blank options block in index.html (option-item divs WITHOUT checkbox-box, using [A]/[B]/[C]): reorder so the correct answer moves to its planned position and re-letter [A]/[B]/[C] sequentially. Most fill-in blocks have 3 options.

For every <table class='match-grid'> in index.html (10 total): reorder the column-B cells (A./B./C./... targets) so the straight-line 1->A,2->B,3->C,4->D pairing is broken, re-letter the B-column prefixes sequentially by new physical row order, and keep each column-A item semantically paired with its correct target. The ans-inputs row below stays as blank input placeholders (unchanged).
Distribute the new correct positions per paper so they are spread across A/B/C/D (roughly even, avoid all-A and avoid a guessable repeating sequence). Vary the pattern between papers.

Update Computer_Std_1_to_10_Question_Papers.md for Std 1 and Std 2 so its MCQ option order/letters, fill-in option order/letters, and match column-B order/letters EXACTLY match the shuffled index.html paper-std-1 and paper-std-2. (These are the only two fully-detailed papers in that markdown file.) Preserve all other content.

Record in the feature 'findings' a per-paper summary table: for each paper (Std 1-10 and the Std1/Std2 markdown mirror) list each question's correct-answer new position, plus the per-paper A/B/C/D distribution. This summary is for the PR description.
acceptance_criteria: In each of the 10 index.html papers, correct answers (as identified in FEAT-001) are spread across positions A/B/C/D rather than concentrated at A, and no paper uses a trivially guessable repeating pattern.
Every options block in index.html has sequential labels (A,B,C,D for MCQ; [A],[B],[C] for 3-option fill-in) with no gaps or duplicates, in reading order.
Each correct-answer TEXT still appears exactly once per question; only its position changed.
Every match-grid column-B ordering breaks the 1->A,2->B,3->C,4->D straight line while keeping semantic pairings correct.
Computer_Std_1_to_10_Question_Papers.md Std 1 and Std 2 option/letter/match orderings are identical to the corresponding shuffled index.html papers.

All Marathi/English text, CSS classes (options-list, option-item, checkbox-box, match-grid, ans-inputs), article ids, display:none attributes, and surrounding markup are unchanged except for reordering and re-lettering.
verification: Programmatically or by inspection, for each options block in index.html confirm the labels read A,B,C,D (or [A],[B],[C]) in order with no gaps.
For paper-std-1 and paper-std-2, diff the MCQ/fill-in/match option ordering against Computer_Std_1_to_10_Question_Papers.md Std 1/Std 2 and confirm they match.
Tally correct-answer positions per paper from the findings summary and confirm a spread distribution (not all A).
Open index.html in a browser (or inspect) and click through the Std 1-10 tabs to confirm no markup breakage and options still render two-per-row as before.
findings:
Shuffled all 10 index.html papers (MCQ, fill-in, match) and kept Computer_Std_1_to_10_Question_Papers.md Std 1 & Std 2 byte-consistent with paper-std-1 / paper-std-2. All edits are pure reorder + re-letter (git diff --stat: index.html 178 insertions / 178 deletions, markdown 19/19). Verified programmatically: every options-list block has sequential labels (A-D MCQ, [A]-[C] fill-in, no gaps/dupes); all 10 match-grid tables have sequential B-column labels (A-D or A-E); HTML parses with a balanced tag stack. Note: audit map treats Std-5 Q.6 correct answer as 'Space Button' (moved C->D) per its recorded plan; applied as specified.

Per-paper correct-answer NEW positions (from audit map, applied):
- Std 1 MCQ: Q1=B, Q2=D, Q3=C, Q4=A, Q5=C | fill: Q6=C, Q7=B, Q8=C | dist A:1 B:2 C:4 D:1. Match: Monitor->C, Keyboard->D, Mouse->B, CPU->A.
- Std 2 MCQ: Q1=C, Q2=A, Q3=D, Q4=B, Q5=C | dist A:1 B:1 C:2 D:1. Match: Keyboard->C, Mouse->A, Monitor->B, CPU->D.
- Std 3 MCQ: Q1=D, Q2=B, Q3=A, Q4=C, Q5=D | dist A:1 B:1 C:1 D:2. Match: Keyboard->B, Mouse->D, Monitor->A, CPU->C.
- Std 4 MCQ: Q1=D, Q2=A, Q3=C, Q4=B, Q5=A | dist A:2 B:1 C:1 D:1. Match: Input->C, Output->A, Keyboard->D, Monitor->B.
- Std 5 MCQ: Q1=B, Q2=D, Q3=A, Q4=B, Q5=C, Q6=D, Q7=A, Q8=C | dist A:2 B:2 C:2 D:2. Match: Monitor->B, Keyboard->A, Mouse->D, CPU->C, AI->E.
- Std 6 MCQ: Q1=C, Q2=D, Q3=A, Q4=B, Q5=D, Q6=A, Q7=B, Q8=D | dist A:2 B:2 C:1 D:3. Match: CPU->C, Monitor->D, Icon->A, Mouse->B, AI->E.
- Std 7 MCQ: Q1=D, Q2=B, Q3=C, Q4=A, Q5=B, Q6=A, Q7=D, Q8=C | dist A:2 B:2 C:2 D:2. Match: CPU->C, Mouse->B, Monitor->A, Keyboard->D.
- Std 8 MCQ: Q1=A, Q2=C, Q3=B, Q4=D, Q5=A, Q6=C, Q7=B | dist A:2 B:2 C:2 D:1. Match: Input->B, Output->C, AI->A, Icon->D.
- Std 9 MCQ: Q1=B, Q2=A, Q3=C, Q4=A, Q5=B, Q6=D, Q7=A, Q8=D | dist A:3 B:2 C:1 D:2. Match: CPU->A, Monitor->B, Keyboard->D, Mouse->C, AI->E.
- Std 10 MCQ: Q1=C, Q2=D, Q3=A, Q4=B, Q5=A, Q6=C, Q7=A, Q8=D, Q9=A, Q10=B | dist A:4 B:2 C:2 D:2. Match: Input->C, Output->B, Monitor->D, CPU->A, Mouse->E.
- Computer markdown Std 1 mirror: MCQ B,D,C,A,C; fill C,B,C; match A.Processing B.Selecting C.Seeing-screen D.Typing (identical to paper-std-1).
- Computer markdown Std 2 mirror: MCQ C,A,D,B,C; match A.Clicking B.Screen C.Typing D.Processing (identical to paper-std-2). Std 2 inline fill-in hints and True/False rows are answer-position stable and left matching index.html.
